seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party takes courier jobs and stumbles into a conspiracy of flesh-creature imposters, illegal augury, and Embercall's radar dishes, becoming Magical Crimes Convox consultants before descending into the sewers and uncovering Grayson's necromantic manor beneath the Quiet Below.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A catastrophic TPK at the Crowded Flea sends Johnny and Benny into the void between life and death, where the entity Aut resurrects them at a cost. The reformed party ambushes and slays Hlarf, then storms Tywelwyn's fiery Fane to kill the burnt husk.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: Post-Tywelwyn discoveries reveal six outer gods attempting to crack the Firmament and a cosmic family called the Narrative. The party attends a massive Pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost, survives a gladiatorial trial and puzzle challenges, and trades a stolen Kellan Quinn painting to the Heart Rapid Connection to claim Keystone 14.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns from death as only half a man, the party enters extended downtime, and a sewer expedition into quarantined Teller's Run reveals a hairline fracture in reality where a two-mile-tall god stands imprisoned behind the Firmament. The party bombs the research compound across the fracture and flees as Teller's Run collapses in a mushroom cloud of ash.

seasons.title: Aboard the Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party embarks on a road trip to the Pilgrimage departure, boards the colossal arachnid Strider, creates their heart Eerie, builds a faction coalition to survive the deadly weekly Tithe, and delves into the Undercroft to awaken the ancient Machine God and secure a powerful alliance.

seasons.title: The End
seasons.arc_summary: The party assaults the sleeping clan's hospital stronghold, then accidentally destroys the Menhir — a member of the cosmic Narrative — with a god-killing revolver, stranding the Strider far starward on a dead, scoured world. Amid faction summit negotiations and the hunt for allies, they free the gunslinger Egan from the Herald's song through a dangerous mind-meld into his memories.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Cagley Middle Finale
seasons.arc_summary: Four 8th-grade heroes descend into the Terror of Cagley's lair beneath Mt. Cagley and slay the shadow demon through stacked fear defenses and a climactic killing blow. The town of Cagley is saved, closing out Noah's one-shot.

seasons.title: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: The convox detectives travel to Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a mysterious visitor, following a Feyrock necklace into the Verdant Expanse where they rescue a boy, confront a fey court, and learn the curse is connected to fey stone.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: The detectives trace fey stone to a jeweler's conference and a ritual apartment, discovering the Gloaming Codex—a book that pulls them into its pages to fight for their lives against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: Sedecium's Long Patrol
seasons.arc_summary: A veteran Sedecium fire team — the wizard Scrazzy, goblin gunslinger Foral, and orc guardian Ozzie — investigates a derelict observatory station half-submerged in the slip, uncovering a trail left by the rogue Thessian Esoterica and a massive magical spike near the Astra's core. They are then pulled from retirement for one last job: a daring raid through the slip and a spider temple to steal divine essence from a dead god before the God Eater Harrow can finish consuming it.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
